title: Rabbah bar Chanina

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as a student of Rav Nachman, citing [Bava Batra 113b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.113b.3), where he recited a teaching before Rav Nachman; Abaye said to him, etc.[^1]

notes.text: Rabbah recites a baraita before Rav Nachman, and Abaye challenges his reading. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3144&lang=en) notes the two exchanges. Hyman infers a teacher–student relationship.
